data.one_liner: Displays large 3D datasets and meshes on a transparent canvas in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Renders static 3D shapes like cubes, faces, lines, meshes, and points efficiently in a Flutter widget. It supports transformations, camera control, lighting, and loading .obj files with materials.
use_when: You need to display static 3D meshes or large datasets in your Flutter app.
You want to load and render 3D models from .obj files.
avoid_when: You are trying to build a complex 3D game engine.
You need advanced physics simulation or real-time skeletal animation.
strengths: Efficiently renders large 3D datasets on a transparent canvas.
Out-of-the-box support for multiple geometric shapes and .obj file parsing.
Provides built-in scene controllers and draggable camera widgets.
weaknesses: Not intended for full 3D game engine features.
Limited to material (.mtl) colors for .obj files.
